verdict.rationale: Synctera is an API-first banking platform, so scoped API credentials for an agent are a fair ask. The evidence only shows that an API key is issued in Sandbox (synctera-docs-14) and that a team admin can grant and change access for human members (synctera-docs-26, synctera-docs-36). Nothing documents scoping or restricting an API key's permissions, so least-privilege agent credentials are unevidenced.
